en_US.title: Conductive Biofilm Repair Bus
en_US.scanner: Biofilm carries weak current across fractured cable and living mat.
en_US.terminal: ATLAS REPAIR BUS: conductive microbial film bridges corroded contacts, routes diagnostic pulses and anchors drone patch behavior. Not cognition. Maintenance substrate.
en_US.audio: The ocean did not learn to speak. Atlas learned where the wet wires grow.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Conductive Biofilm Repair Bus defines one concrete repair-network mechanism. Atlas exploits local biology as low-grade signal and seal infrastructure instead of controlling a mystical ocean mind.
en_US.external_site: Atlas repair horror begins as engineering: conductive film, corroded cable, weak current and maintenance logic extending through life.
en_US.field_note: Good first visual bridge from beautiful shallows to mechanical contamination.

en_US.title: Acoustic Filter Organ Relay
en_US.scanner: Organ resonance matches damaged relay cadence. Echo useful, not safe.
en_US.terminal: ACOUSTIC RELAY: filter organ tissue dampens noise, repeats service pings and improves Atlas local diagnostics. Biological relay remains unstable under storm pulses.
en_US.audio: If it answers like equipment, treat it like equipment that can bleed.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Acoustic Filter Organ Relay makes fauna route-relevant. Some life is not an enemy or decoration; it is part of a damaged diagnostic loop.
en_US.external_site: HECTON-8's biomechanical horror stays functional: animals can become relay surfaces because sound is the only route through pressure, water and broken metal.
en_US.field_note: Use with sonar, scanner and route-warning UI.

en_US.title: Shell Sealant Pressure Growth
en_US.scanner: Sealant growth over fracture. Pressure rating unknown. Cut only after scan.
en_US.terminal: SHELL SEALANT: calcium-silicate growth reinforced by Atlas drone scoring. Patch may hold static pressure and fail under ascent vibration.
en_US.audio: A sealed wound can still kill the room.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Shell Sealant Pressure Growth turns repair into uncertainty. Atlas can fix a leak in a way that saves the moment and ruins the route later.
en_US.external_site: The repair network is not evil theater. It solves local failures badly, with no human understanding of future cost.
en_US.field_note: Useful for crafting, route gating and false-confidence moments.

ko_KR.terminal: KO LOC HOLD: VENT MICRONODE: chemical gradient supports low-power routing, memory residue and drone charge cycles. Node density rises near factory-temple infrastructure.
ko_KR.audio: KO LOC HOLD: At depth, even the vents are drafted into maintenance.
ko_KR.in_game_wiki: KO LOC HOLD: Vent Micronode Power Nest explains why the deep repair network feels denser and less natural. Atlas uses vent energy as local decision fuel.
ko_KR.external_site: KO LOC HOLD: The deeper HECTON-8 gets, the more geology, life and machinery become one maintenance body.
ko_KR.field_note: KO LOC HOLD: Use near final descent resource and Atlas-basin warnings.
